🚉 COTTAM PARKWAY FINALLY GETS ITS MONEY

The Lancashire Combined County Authority has approved £28.2m for the new Cottam Parkway station — serving around 17,000 households in west Preston and an expected 644,000 journeys a year.

Good news, and I'll say so. But here's the sting: government allocated £28.4m in July 2025 and the bill then soared past £55m, largely through inflation. Provisional opening date? December 2030. 😐

Delay is never free — the taxpayer pays for the same station twice.
